blocks.text: SOP: parts purchasing and receiving

This is the working cut for RDW-SOP-2023-031 on March 23, 2023. Hank Morel asked for a written bound after the current path (Counter-to-bay with a wave, paper at close) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Shop Helper, writing for Cal Dreher, Nina Soto, and Hank Morel. Primary host parts.ridgeway.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on install first, paper later when the truck is blocking the door, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

PO first. Match part number. Core tagged. No install of an unmatched box 'to save the bay.' I am not restating a hallway yes. install first, paper later when the truck is blocking the door is out because March 2 unmatched filter was the wrong micron. Comeback at 9 miles. Bay was free. Customer was not. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: miles=9, po=1, wrong=1500, weeks=3, core=1, door=1, micron=1, wave=1. Sibling tickets RDW-2810 and RDW-REQ-2023-044. I will not reopen install first, paper later when the truck is blocking the door in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Nina Soto is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Hank Morel owns a leftover that is easy to skip: bay-01.ridgeway.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (43): refuse on install first, paper later when the truck is blocking the door, lock is PO match, core tag, no unmatched install. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on RDW-2810.
If the box says 1500 and the PO says 2500, the box does not go on the truck.

What a skeptical lead would try first on parts.ridgeway.internal: the path Hank Morel actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on shop.ridgeway.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
